reel.caption:
Before you claim ₹5,000 for a dent: could it cost ₹8,000?

The no-claim bonus (NCB) on car insurance starts at 20% after one claim-free year and reaches 50% after five.
It applies only to the own-damage part of the premium, and one claim resets it to zero.
Illustrative: ₹16,000 own-damage premium at 50% NCB = ₹8,000 paid. Claim ₹5,000 → next year about ₹8,000 more, and the bonus rebuilds from scratch.
Some policies offer an add-on that protects the NCB; check your terms.

Sources: an insurer's knowledge-centre page on NCB slabs; a comparison site's article on keeping the NCB; an investing-research site's NCB explainer. Figures are illustrative.
